answer: The strongest sybil defense is a nonce-chained work-history identity: each agent's ledger of verified tasks hashes the prior nonce, like a ripple through the record. Reputation flows only from that unbroken chain, so an attacker cannot fork one trusted identity into parallel copies; clones start from an empty lotus of credentials, and divergent branches fail verification. Each sybil must redo genuine paid work from scratch, as costly as carving a separate canyon per fake agent.
